title: feat: add switchable official app requests KPI
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds one Official apps requests row: All plus individual verified CLI, Play/Website, Open WebUI, Playground and other official app keys. Reuses existing switch/graph controls and CSV export.
- Counts successful final requests through BYOP or direct app keys once; excludes internal/dev, legacy and community-model traffic. Unavailable data stays blank, not zero.
- Verified: 54 KPI tests, client/Worker production build, Biome, live read-only query (15,068 requests for Sep 21–27; per-key sum matches All), and Tinybird staging dry run.
- Deployment prerequisite: deploy the new Tinybird endpoint/read grant to staging then production before promoting the dashboard. No deployment performed: staging dry run also lists unrelated quest migrations and deletion of account_notice_payment_required; reconcile those separately. Merge only, no production promotion.

gist.headline: One graph, several gardens
gist.blurb: The KPI dashboard gets a switchable view of official-app requests. One row for the whole garden, or a closer look at each verified app key.
gist.summary: Adds an Official apps requests KPI with All and per-key views for verified CLI, Play/Website, Open WebUI, Playground, and other official apps, using a new Tinybird endpoint and the dashboard’s existing graph and CSV controls.
gist.impact: The team can compare successful final requests across official apps, counting BYOP and direct app-key requests once while leaving unavailable data blank and excluding internal, legacy, and community-model traffic.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the internal KPI dashboard as a cozy retro monitor with a switch between an All graph and several smaller official-app graphs; a tiny CSV printout suggests export. Polli, wearing little analyst glasses, studies the graph beside a sprouting code-plant. Avoid implying that the dashboard is already deployed.
